annotations.title: Market conditions gate: regime and stress in one call

description: What are US market conditions right now, in one small call? Returns the current Regime Card regime (Risk-On to Risk-Off) and the stress gate's overall state (Calm, Elevated or Stressed) with how many of its three components are confirmed (N of 3). Conditions only: no percentile, no per-component detail, no history. $0.002 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). The regime and the stress gate each update about once an hour while the US market is open, the first a little after 10 AM ET. The top-level asOf and status are the regime's; the stress gate carries its own. Useful when an agent checks market conditions before every action and needs the smallest answer at the lowest price.
name: conditions_gate

asOf.description: The trading session of the regime (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern): /v1/live's asOf at the same moment. The stress gate's own is stress.asOf.

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

nextUpdateAt.description: The expected time of the next update to the regime or the stress gate (UTC). When one hourly update is due to both, this is the time both are expected to be in; otherwise, whichever comes first. An expectation, not a promise: it counts the scheduled updates of US trading sessions, and one can arrive a little earlier or later. A later correction to a settled reading is not counted. A recompute of the stress gate on a market holiday is not counted.

record.description: The public, hash-linked record of the daily settled regime reading: its percentile and its regime label. It covers nothing else in this response: not the stress gate, stock or coin figures, the scorecard, or a live intraday reading. The same on every response.

covers.description: The reading it covers: the percentile and the regime label of each daily settled reading, and nothing else in this response.

ledger.description: Every entry as JSON, each with the hash of the entry before it.

note.const: Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
note.description: The same facts in one plain sentence.

verify.description: The page that explains the hash chain and checks every entry in the browser.

regime.description: The current regime, as /v1/live gives it in reading.regime: the live reading's while the top-level status is "live", else the last settled close's.

key.description: The regime, as a stable key.

label.description: The regime, as the card prints it.

related.description: The other paid routes: for each, its path, the question it answers and its price per call. Each is a separate call.

path.description: The route's path on this origin.

per.description: What the price is for: one call, or each covered symbol of one call.

priceUsd.description: The price in US dollars, paid in USDC.

status.description: The regime's status, as /v1/live gives it: "live" while its reading is computed during the session and still provisional, "settled" when it is the last settled close. The stress gate's own is stress.status.

stress.description: The stress gate's overall state, as /v1/stress gives it: the state, how many of its three components are confirmed, its own session and status, and when it was last computed. No component is named.

asOf.description: The stress gate's own trading session (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern): /v1/stress's asOf at the same moment. It can be an earlier session than the top-level asOf, which is the regime's.

confirmed.description: How many of the three components are confirmed.

stale.description: True when the gate has not been recomputed on schedule.

key.description: The gate's state, as a key.

status.description: The stress gate's own status, as /v1/stress gives it: "live" when it was computed in the US session open now, "settled" otherwise. The top-level status is the regime's.

updatedAt.description: When the gate was last computed (UTC).

title: Market conditions gate: regime and stress in one call
